verdict.rationale: Unleash's own docs say the Admin API provides "full programmatic access to manage all resources within Unleash, including feature flags, projects, environments, users, and integrations" (unleash-docs-48, unleash-docs-6). API tokens are documented for automation and other tools (unleash-docs-23), which supports the UI-parity claim at the level of resource coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that every UI action (e.g. change requests, release templates, RBAC role management) is exposed via the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of that parity.
